overrides.reason: Miniflare's local image tooling pins a Sharp release containing vulnerable libheif decoders. HQ does not use that image-processing path, but the development toolchain must use the patched decoder.
overrides.removeWhen: Remove the override after both the development and test toolchains stop requesting Sharp 0.35.2, and the regenerated lockfile contains no Sharp version affected by this advisory.

overrides.reason: Miniflare pins an Undici release whose WebSocket decompression error handling can terminate the process. The development and test toolchains must use the patched release.
overrides.removeWhen: Remove the override after every installed Miniflare release stops requesting Undici 7.29.0, and the regenerated lockfile contains no Undici version affected by this advisory.
